issues.description: getCategoryLabel silently complects heuristics with the data it used to encode
issues.detail: The old adapter held an explicit mapping from category id to label — a value. The new lib/categories.ts replaces that value with a chain of regex and length heuristics plus an empty SPECIAL_CASES dict. The data the API actually emits is now implicit in code paths. Keep the explicit map as the source of truth; fall back to heuristics only for unknowns, and log when the fallback fires.

issues.description: Three-character rule will mislabel real words as acronyms
issues.detail: `word.length <= 3` upper-cases any short token: 'web' becomes 'WEB', 'aws' fine, but 'new', 'old', 'all', 'log' all become shouty. This is essential-vs-incidental confusion: the problem is 'which tokens are acronyms', not 'which tokens are short'. Either enumerate the acronyms as data or get the labels from the API.

issues.description: SEVERITY_ORDER now has two keys mapping to 4 — duplicate identity for one value
issues.detail: Adding `Info: 4` alongside `Informational: 4` means two distinct strings denote the same rank. If any code path sorts or groups by this map it will encounter a non-injective relation. Normalize the input ('Info' -> 'Informational') at the edge instead of carrying two names for one fact through the system.

issues.description: Category selector treats selectedPoint as both selection-identity and filter-state
issues.detail: `selectedPoint` is being used to mean (a) which radar dot is highlighted and (b) which dropdown value is chosen and (c) the data payload for the detail panel. Three concerns share one piece of state. Separate selectedCategoryId (identity) from the derived point (value computed from data + id) so the dropdown and the dot reference the same id, not a stale snapshot of data.

issues.description: HorizontalBarChart recomputes maxValue on every row inside the map
issues.detail: `Math.max(...data.map((d) => d.value))` runs per row and the displayPercentage / calculatedWidth logic now has two nearly identical `??` chains. Lift max and total to one place above the map and compute a small derived array of {width, displayPercent} per row — the values become explicit and the render stays a pure function of data.

issues.description: CategorySelector uses sentinel string 'all' to mean null — easy, not simple
issues.detail: The component maps null <-> 'all' at both ends because the underlying Select rejects empty values. Familiar workaround, but it complects 'no selection' with a category id namespace. A thin wrapper that exposes (value: string | null) once, or a clearly reserved sentinel constant, keeps the null-vs-id distinction explicit instead of stringly-typed.

review.summary: The PR is mostly mechanical text renames plus a real refactor: an explicit id->label map gets replaced by a heuristic function, and category filtering is wired into findings. The biggest concern is the loss of an explicit data table in favor of length-and-regex heuristics that will mislabel short real words and silently swallow new ids without telling anyone. State in the radar view complects selection identity with selected value, and the duplicate Info/Informational key in SEVERITY_ORDER introduces a non-injective rank map. None of these are catastrophic; all of them are familiar choices standing in for simpler decompositions.
